title: Runtime handoff bootstrap
description: Enforces canonical agent handoffs, creates a clean Git bus branch, and bootstraps the local gateway service.

requirements.summary: Require a canonical GPT-authored agent handoff
acceptance: AC-001: Every executable patch pack must contain AGENT_HANDOFF.md.
AC-002: The handoff must be a bounded regular non-symlink file with all required canonical headings.
AC-003: Unresolved placeholders and handoffs that do not identify the manifest patch, repository, base revision, and immutable workflow pin are rejected before execution.

requirements.summary: Use the handoff as the only local-agent instruction entry point
acceptance: AC-004: The gateway copies the validated GPT-authored handoff to the local task root and appends authoritative machine-local runtime paths.
AC-005: The Airelay prompt is a single short line pointing only to the generated AGENT_HANDOFF.md.
AC-006: The gateway no longer generates a competing agent-request.md instruction document.

requirements.summary: Standardize the local agent response contract
acceptance: AC-007: The local Markdown response path is AGENT_RESPONSE.md.
AC-008: The machine result remains agent-result.json and successful result verification remains unchanged.
AC-009: Documentation and repository agent policy use the same canonical names.

requirements.summary: Bootstrap a clean dedicated Git bus branch
acceptance: AC-010: If the configured bus branch does not exist, the gateway creates it as an orphan branch rather than inheriting the typer main tree.
AC-011: Concurrent first-creation races recover by recloning the newly created remote branch.
AC-012: The clean bus branch contains only gateway-owned runtime content and its own short README baseline.
AC-013: A single script installs the Go binary, creates or reuses local configuration, registers the project, and starts the daemon.
AC-014: Bootstrap verifies process status, doctor output, and loopback readiness before succeeding.
AC-015: Credentials and machine-sensitive Airelay configuration remain local and are not written to the Git bus.
AC-016: Native Go tests cover valid, incomplete, placeholder-containing, and runtime-augmented handoffs.
AC-017: No third-party Go dependency is introduced.
AC-018: Version and changelog advance to 0.1.1.

gates.name: Home gateway service bootstrap
gates.command: PRIMARY_REPO=$(git worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | head -n 1) && bash scripts/bootstrap-local.sh --gateway home_pc --project-path "$PRIMARY_REPO" --resume-session 019efe9b-294a-7362-84da-875a68bbd645

gpt_static_checks_performed: Inspected the merged gateway implementation and its committed evidence on GitHub.
Authored complete Go source, native tests, protocol documentation, bootstrap shell code, and an executable Git patch.
Checked manifest and patch file-operation scope consistency.
Parsed JSON and Python artifacts and checked shell syntax without executing project runtime gates.
Performed source-level Go parsing and type inspection without building or testing the project.
gpt_runtime_checks_not_performed: go fmt ./... as an acceptance gate
live Airelay session start and prompt flow
live Git bus orphan-branch creation and publication
daemon process, doctor, and loopback readiness checks
known_integration_risks: The user-provided Codex resume session ID must still be valid on home_pc.
Host Git identity and SSH credentials must permit creation of the ai-workspace-bus branch in rceman/typer.
An existing local gateway config with a different gateway identity requires owner review rather than forced overwrite.
The agent must validate git apply --3way against the exact remote base commit; GPT artifact validation used a content-equivalent reconstructed repository for direct patch application.
forbidden_deviations: Do not weaken or bypass AGENT_HANDOFF.md validation.
Do not restore agent-request.md as a competing instruction source.
Do not replace Airelay with direct codex exec.
Do not create the Git bus branch from the typer main working tree.
Do not force-overwrite an existing local configuration without owner authorization.
Do not add third-party Go dependencies or broaden the local agent role.
